title: Contract for counter-loop escape
statement: Let $a$ and $e$ be distinct states, and suppose a round contract for a machine with anchor $a$ has escape set $\{e\}$. Given an embedding of Boolean symbols into the machine's alphabet, construct a contract for the counter-loop machine starting in its decrement phase with the run flag. Its data consist of an original parameter, a Boolean counter word, and a natural number $t$. The precondition requires the encoded counter word on the extra tape, $t$ strictly less than its counter value, every round through round $t$ to satisfy the round precondition, all rounds before $t$ to end at the anchor, and round $t$ to end at $e$. The exact running time sums the round times for rounds $0$ through $t$, together with the counter overhead for $t+1$ rounds. The endpoint is the escaped configuration after $t+1$ rounds with the extra tape set to the counter word decremented $t+1$ times; the head-position bounds are the round bounds on the original tapes, and on the extra tape they are one cell before its initial head position and that position plus the counter-word length.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of original work tapes
An embedding of Boolean symbols into $\Gamma$
A machine with $k$ work tapes over $\Gamma$ and states $S$
A parameter type and finite input word over $\Gamma$
A round contract for the machine with anchor $a$ and escape set $\{e\}$
A Boolean counter word and natural number $t$ in the contract's data
caveat: The semantics of the auxiliary counter-word and endpoint constructions are not supplied, so their description is limited to their explicit use in the definition.
